### Divine Bondsmen
Author: Darlene Franklin
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/wholly-loved-feb-22.html
Passage: Isaiah 58:6
Points:
- Fasting is a longstanding spiritual practice, but God rejects rituals performed merely for show.
- God's chosen fast turns outward rather than inward to relieve the suffering of others.
- Believers are called to treat others fairly and actively defend those trapped in oppression.
- Faithful ministry must address both physical burdens and the spiritual bondage of sin.

### The Time Challenge
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-nov-17.html
Passage: Isaiah 58:6-7
Points:
- True spiritual sacrifice includes faithfully caring for one's own family.
- Parents facing difficult circumstances must make intentional personal sacrifices of time for their children.
- Material gifts and phone calls cannot replace a parent's consistent, loving presence.
- Parents need God's grace and wisdom to gain the endurance required to raise children well.

### I Know How to Manipulate
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/i-know-how-to-manipulate-encouragement-for-today-october-31-2013.html
Passage: Isaiah 58:11
Points:
- Personal talents and strategic skills can easily cross into manipulative self-reliance.
- Pushing ahead of God's timing often results in stress, anxiety, and regret.
- Stepping back and relinquishing control allows God to grant what only He can provide.
- Believers can rely on the Lord to guide, strengthen, and nourish them in scorched seasons.

### Compassion, Part Two
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-november-26-2014.html
Passage: Isaiah 58:6-12
Points:
- External religious practices and correct doctrine are hollow without authentic compassion.
- God calls His people to actively undo oppressive burdens and care for the needy.
- Serving as repairers and restorers requires getting our hands dirty in real-life problems.
- Extending practical compassion breaks down barriers and creates a hunger for God's truth.
